::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [“early” 1866]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown. This fragment printed in Christabel Maxwell, <i>[Mrs. Gatty and Mrs. Ewing](other_books/otherbook_306.qmd)</i>, (1949) 144.
:::

[To [Margaret Gatty](people/person_549.qmd)]

Pray tell [Juliana](people/person_494.qmd) that I have been told of a master at Rugby who was so fascinated with [The Brownies](other_books/otherbook_448.qmd) that he ordered all the 30 old volumes of the [magazine](organizations/other_52.qmd) for his house!

---

**Note:** ‘The Brownies’ had appeared in the *MP* (December 1865). Maxwell writes: 'Early in 1866 there was a letter from Miss Yonge to say that it [the Brownies] had evoked a perfect chorus of approval and in her opinion it had been the most successful that they had had in the *Monthly Packet* for a long time.' This letter was sent “shortly afterwards”.
